stages.title: Design a Product

stages.purpose: Ingest payments across touchpoints, clear and authorise against schemes, project ledger accounting, calculate settlements, execute funds movement, recover fees, and feed analytics.

views.source_notes: Derived from the structured text feed the whiteboard's owner authored for this purpose (https://tyropaymentsltd.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARCH/pages/2382233611/Payment+target+state+WIP+AI+feed). The whiteboard body itself is not readable through the Atlassian connector -- only its metadata and a ~260-character indexed text extract -- so the feed page is the machine-readable source and the whiteboard is the human original. Both are WIP. Deliberate divergences from the feed, curated here (decision 60 in docs/decision-log.md): the actor 'Customer (self-serve / merchant)' is titled 'Merchant', and the edge 'Cross-domain reports CONSUMED_BY Customer (Merchant portal insights)' is removed -- it was the graph's only backwards (stage 3 to stage 2) edge.

nodes.title: Payments Product Domain
nodes.purpose: Own Tyro’s merchant acquiring product as a coherent offering across channels , by defining the product-level rules, entitlements, and lifecycle that sit above merchant configuration and below commercial pricing. It provides the authoritative “product view” for acquiring—what capabilities exist, how they’re packaged, and which features apply to which customer cohort—without becoming a system-of-record for transactions or balances.

nodes.title: Product Quoting & Pricing

disputes-and-recovery.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: scheme chargebacks and recovery. Banking disputes would widen this.
disputes-and-recovery.purpose: Manage disputes arising from payments acquiring across two coupled workflows: scheme-managed dispute progression (chargebacks, retrieval requests, representment) and Tyro's own economic recovery, publishing authoritative scheme and recovery outcomes to downstream consumers.

not_authoritative_for.content: Transaction master record, authorisation state; Scheme clearing ingestion & clearing truth (incl. clearing adjustments as records)
Merchant payout calculation, settlement batches, merchant payable balances, application of debits/credits
Payment GL journals and statutory books
Commercial pricing plans / product fee rules (Disputes may *trigger* fee commitments; it does not own fee plan policy.)
Fraud policy ownership / risk decision policy

payments-vas-integrations.title: Payments VAS Integrations Domain
payments-vas-integrations.purpose: Enable and operate value-added services that are invoked within the acquiring payment flow , by integrating Tyro’s acceptance and payment flows with approved third-party providers. It is authoritative for VAS invocation, provider abstraction, and VAS outcomes—not for transaction truth.

pos-integration.title: POS Integration Domain
pos-integration.purpose: Define and operate the POS integration surface for Tyro acquiring so POS vendors can initiate and manage payment flows reliably and consistently across supported channels . This domain owns the technical integration model for POS → Tyro , not the commercial partnership and not cross-ecosystem certification governance.

banking-vas-integrations.title: Banking VAS Integrations Domain
banking-vas-integrations.purpose: This domain exists to keep the regulated Banking ledger clean and stable while allowing external ecosystem services to plug in modularly. It owns the consent model and partner-facing orchestration of banking workflows—not ledger truth or rail execution.

not_authoritative_for.content: Transfer execution on rails (NPP/BECS/internal), return codes

Integration certification lifecycle and conformance evidence

Customer-facing UX composition (this domain supplies APIs/events; channels render)

partner-developer-experience.title: Partner Developer Experience Domain
partner-developer-experience.purpose: It exists to prevent partner experience and tooling from fragmenting across product-specific integration domains. This domain is authoritative for the experience and tooling layer of partner development—not the product integration specifications, not certification decisions, and not partner commercial lifecycle.

POS integration specifications and runtime connectivity

integration-enablement-and-certification.title: Integration Enablement & Certification Domain
integration-enablement-and-certification.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: scheme and device certification dominate. Partner API enablement leans tyro-wide.
integration-enablement-and-certification.purpose: This domain owns the certification lifecycle and conformance truth: what is certified, for which versions, with what scope, and whether it is production-eligible.

enterprise-data-governance.title: Enterprise Data Governance Domain
enterprise-data-governance.purpose: Provide Tyro’s enterprise-wide data governance, assurance, and control framework so data across domains is trusted, secure, compliant, and reusable — without owning operational business truth or regulatory policy. Risk & Compliance domains remain responsible for regulatory interpretation and policy setting. Enterprise Data Governance enables compliance to those policies through defined data standards and control frameworks.

not_authoritative_for.content: Authoritative business semantics; systems of record
Data pipeline implementation; analytical marts and dashboards

data-analytics-and-intelligence.title: Data Analytics & Intelligence Domain
data-analytics-and-intelligence.purpose: Provide Tyro’s technical foundation and operational capability to ingest, transform, store, and serve data as trusted, reusable data products — enabling analytics and cross-domain insights while not owning operational master truth. Operational domains remain authoritative for business invariants.

ai-and-ml.title: AI & ML Domain
ai-and-ml.purpose: Productionise AI and ML capabilities safely and reliably across Tyro by providing shared lifecycle tooling, operational controls, and governance mechanisms — while keeping business decision authority in relevant domains. This capability is the system of record for AI/ML operational artefacts — not for business decision policy.

customer-and-product-onboarding.title: Customer & Product Onboarding
customer-and-product-onboarding.purpose: Orchestrate the end-to-end process from prospect → application → assessment → approval → product activation across one or more products . Owns the application workflow state machine and sequencing, while delegating decisions and record creation to authoritative domains.

customer-lifecycle-management.title: Customer Lifecycle Management
customer-lifecycle-management.purpose: Coordinate lifecycle transitions for active customers/products , such as suspension, reactivation, upgrades/downgrades, product add-ons, and offboarding. Ensures lifecycle policies are applied consistently across multiple product domains without embedding cross-domain workflow logic inside them.

product-bundling-and-eligibility.title: Product Bundling & Eligibility
product-bundling-and-eligibility.purpose: Define and orchestrate how Tyro sells and manages multi-product bundles , including eligibility checks, bundle composition rules, and cross-product activation coordination. This prevents bundling logic being scattered across product domains and sales tools.

product-quoting-and-pricing.title: Product Quoting & Pricing
product-quoting-and-pricing.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: prices all products, though acquiring MSF / interchange-plus pricing is its most complex case.
product-quoting-and-pricing.purpose: Define, govern, and apply Tyro’s commercial revenue logic across products and channels—so pricing, fees, revenue share, and commissions are consistent, versioned, auditable, and reusable across Payments, Banking, Lending, Financial Management, and partner-led propositions. It is authoritative for commercial policy and calculation, not for scheme fees, ledger entries, invoicing, or settlement.

not_authoritative_for.content: Scheme/network fees and clearing-level fees; Transaction truth and volumes (Revenue consumes as input)
Deposit ledger balances and interest accrual
Group/franchise hierarchy (and policy specifics may sit in Groups & Enterprises )
Group/franchise hierarchy (and policy specifics may sit in Groups & Enterprises )

operational-case-management.title: Operational Case Management
operational-case-management.purpose: A shared and generic enterprise capability for operational case management, investigations, evidence handling, and exception workflow orchestration across multiple domains. Manage cross-domain operational exceptions and investigations that require multi-team workflows, evidence, and audit trails—such as reconciliation breaks, disputes coordination, compliance investigations, fraud escalations, and complex operational incidents. This domain owns the workflow of exceptions, not the underlying product records.

customer-notifications-and-communication.title: Customer Notifications & Communications
customer-notifications-and-communication.purpose: Decide what communications to send, when, and through which channel, based on events from authoritative domains—ensuring regulated communications are compliant, templates are managed, delivery is tracked, and customer communication logic isn’t duplicated across product systems.
